name: STURDeCAM25_CUOAGX

sources.title: STURDeCAM25_CUOAGX - FHD AR0234 IP67 Global Shutter GMSL2 Multi Camera for NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin / AGX Xavier (up to 8 cameras) (e-con Systems product page)
sources.covers: sensor, shutter, pixel size, optical format, active area, FOV with e-con's lens, focus, interface, cable length, frame rates, output format, power (6 cameras), serializer and deserializer board sizes

note: A GMSL2 camera for NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin and AGX Xavier, up to 8 cameras on e-con's deserializer board (75 x 55 mm, its other figures not stated). The FOV 111.1 (H) x 68.3 (V) x 132.8 (D) degrees is stated "with the lens provided by e-con", taken to refer to the full 1920 x 1200 array (not said). The lens model is pinhole, a labelled assumption: the maker states no projection or distortion, and the stated horizontal, vertical and diagonal angles do not fit one distortion-free pinhole with square pixels (a wide lens with barrel distortion), so a pinhole fitted to the horizontal and vertical angles has non-square pixels and misplaces the corners; calibrate a unit and store its K and D in the sensor calibration. Frame rates are stated as "2.3 MP @ 60 fps", "Full HD @ 65 fps" and "HD @ 120 fps", uncompressed UYVY; 2.3 MP is the 1920 x 1200 active area, and Full HD and HD are entered as 1920 x 1080 and 1280 x 720, the sizes e-con's See3CAM_24CUG datasheet gives for those names (an interpretation: this page does not give the pixel sizes). power_w is null: the page states only "10.681W (6 cameras streaming condition)" for the system, not per camera. mass_g is not stated. size_mm is the serializer (camera) housing, 42 x 42 x 45.22 mm, entered as [45.22, 42, 42] on the reading that the longest side is along the optical axis (an assumption). Not stated: f-number, focal length, distortion. Cable length "15m" (FAKRA); operating voltage 5 to 15 V; IP67.
interface: GMSL2 (FAKRA); "High speed 4-lane MIPI CSI-2 interface" on the Jetson side
